notes: English default:34706 explicitly lists Virki among Erathell's Alfar strongholds; default:4974/54888/62113 describes its water-gates and their connection to Tywili Coast. Japanese ヴァーキ and Chinese 维尔吉 corroborate the same place. Reuse the dominant base/standalone Korean 비르키(Virki), replacing the two 버르키 variants and pairing repeated mentions locally. Base:1307 separately labels Virki Upstairs; Japanese ヴァーキの上り階段 and Chinese 维尔吉楼上 corroborate the upstairs destination. Retain the English meaning and Korean 위층, pairing the whole label as 비르키 위층(Virki Upstairs). The official Korean manual PDF p. 7 explains map destinations and quest targets, not this fortress's name. All three resources were searched; matches occur only in base/default. Existing Anela, Culn and other entity/row dispositions are not reopened.
